trainer/30156.htm.text: Master Covendell: Welcome, friend! Are you here to learn the song of swordsmanship? Archery, perhaps? If you have the desire to learn, I will impart to you all my experience and knowledge.

trainer/30156-noteach.htm.text: Master Cobendell: I train Elven Fighters. I have nothing to teach you. If you seek knowledge, find another Master.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30156-03.html.text: Master Cobendell: To create a Healing Potion to treat the fever, I need the dryad's tear , where the purest life forces of the earth are concentrated. Long ago the dryads were beautiful spirits of the trees that sang of the life force of the earth. However, after the balance of magic powers flowing…

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30156-04.html.text: Master Cobendell: My dear friend, did you not agree to bring me ten Dryad's Tears? I must create a Healing Potion before the poisons of the spores spread throughout the entire village. Please hurry.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30156-05.html.text: Master Cobendell: My friend, you have done well to return. Have you gathered all the Dryad's Tears? Ah, excellent. Please wait a moment. All I need to do is add the Dryad's Tears to the mixture that I have prepared. Here, I have created the five potions that are needed most immediately. Please deli…

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30156-06.html.text: Master Cobendell: Please deliver the Dryad's Tears potion that I have made to Sentinel Knight Alberius . Alberius is standing guard at the terrace of the building directly in front of us.

Q00102_SeaOfSporesFever/30156-07.html.text: Master Cobendell: I hear that Alberius has asked you to deliver the medicine to all the Sentinels that traveled to the Sea of Spores? Have you delivered them all? They are all healthy individuals, and there's probably no need to worry, but it's best to have them take the medication. Better safe tha…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
